name: Method C Isoparametric Bilinear Gauss-Point Transfer Implementation and Offline Parity Qualification
description: Formulation, implementation, and offline qualification of a gradient-preserving bilinear Gauss-point history transfer operator on Mode-I C5 donor state (Job 1419566 Checkpoint 03, 12,996 elements). Strictly 0 PBS submissions authorized.

governance.directive: OPTION 1 — APPROVE THE DIAGNOSTIC FINDING AND AUTHORIZE OFFLINE GP-TRANSFER REMEDIATION QUALIFICATION

requirements: Establish authentic donor GP numbering and isoparametric coordinates
Calculate receiver-GP physical coordinates and donor-element local coordinates via verified inverse isoparametric mapping
Demonstrate exact C5-to-C5 GP history identity to numerical precision (max |Delta H| <= 1e-4 MPa across all 51,984 GP values)
Evaluate C5-to-C6 receiver mapping with slit-flank isolation and host-element boundary checks
Implement safeguarded extrapolation limiting outside the donor GP rectangle preserving nonnegativity (H >= 0) and physical driving bounds
Preserve historical irreversibility and verify consistency with tensile-energy driving force
Compare old element-mean and proposed GP reconstruction using field-error statistics and crack-tip profiles
Verify production-path regression: zero silent changes to nodal displacement, damage, donor checkpoints, UEL constitutive behavior, or acceptance tolerances
Keep corrected candidate separate from frozen production transfer and qualified R11 package until independent review
